'''Tonkotsu ramen''' is one of the oven meals. It heals {{Hp|20}} and grants {{EffectLink|Haste}} II for 30 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/ramen.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Ramen Stock]] cooks into tonkotsu ramen in 15 seconds in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]]. Obtaining the stock unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 3 seconds, heals {{Hp|20}} and gives Haste II for 30:00. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].

== Advancements ==
* ''The Best Soup!'': make ramen (1 [[obol]]).

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|The stock uses oil and accepts seitan.}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Its translation key is <code>item.kleispack.ramen</code>. It is unrelated to the leftover [[ramen]] item.
